name: Imperial Capital
basis: The Eastern Empire marker on the supplied annotated map. The corpus places the capital inside the Empire and gives no finer location.

name: Imperial border base (assembly area)
basis: The assembly area of the invasion column before it marched. Placed just inside the Empire on the bearing from the capital towards the Great Jura Forest, so that the approach march reads as leaving the Empire westward. The corpus states only 'Eastern Empire'. The text shows "a large number of troops gathered around the security base" at the military border (v12.txt:11829-11831): this is that base.

name: Great Jura Forest
basis: The forest surrounds the Tempest capital. Placed just north-east of the MEASURED Tempest marker, between Tempest and the Dwargon approach, which is the sector the campaign is fought in.

name: Imperial halt point (forest edge)
basis: Where the single 1,005,000-strong main formation halts and splits (scenario). The novels say only that the army halted inside Tempest territory "soon after" the month mark (v13.txt:341-346). Placed by the travel-time constraints the halt must satisfy under the calibrated scale: the infantry must reach a camp about 30 km from Rimuru (v13.txt:386-389) and the magitanks a position about 30 km from Dwargon (v13.txt:513-515) by D+0 morning at the novels' stated march rates (docs/GEOGRAPHIC_MODEL.md). West of the upper ford of the eastern river, on the forest side.

name: Tempest border
basis: The point where the imperial line of march (imperial-interior -> jura-forest-edge) crosses the Empire-Jura border drawn on the Base Map, found by tracing the march axis across the traced territory polygons (R5 cartographic check). The border line is MEASURED. The crossing point on it is RECONSTRUCTED, since the novels name no crossing place.

name: Southwestern Dwargon front
basis: Scenario: Formation B (the Magitank Force) attacks Dwargon through its south-western border. The novels array the 2,000 magitanks about thirty kilometres from the centre of Dwargon, facing the front gate (v13.txt:513-517). Placed 30 km south-south-west of Dwargon under the calibrated scale, at the head of the south-western valley.

name: Dwargon southern gate (front door)
basis: The gate the magitanks' muzzles face, which Rimuru had visited several times (v13.txt:516-517). Tempest's troops camp there and the Dwarven Knights raise earth walls before it. On the southern road about 18 km from the city.

name: Airspace over the southwestern Dwargon front
basis: Directly above sw-dwargon-front: the Flying Combat Corps arrives over the magitank battle (v13.txt:3065).

name: Ramiris Labyrinth
basis: The labyrinth lies beneath the Tempest capital, so it takes the MEASURED Tempest position. It is a subsurface theatre and is rendered as such. Two theatres share this ground position by design, not by error.

name: Dwargon Gate (eastern metropolis, Isthmus)
basis: Dwargon's gate east of the city, at the Isthmus, facing the Empire (v13.txt:697-699), five hundred kilometres south-west of the imperial capital (v14.txt:10863-10866, 575 km under the calibrated scale). The single Dwargon Gate location of the scenario: the 5,000 detachment blockades it and the Gate force (30,000 + 30,000) masses before it.

name: Dwargon eastern front
basis: The battle line outside the Dwargon Gate on the isthmus plain, one step east of the gate.

name: Airspace over the Great Jura Forest
basis: The dragon engagement takes place over the forest. Same ground position as great-jura-forest, air layer.

name: Airlift in flight (position not stated)
basis: The Magic Beast Division's airship regiment in flight toward northern Ingracia, from where it was to attack (v15.txt:3431-3435, 3452-3463). The novel gives no position. By Rimuru's reckoning it was still more than three days from Dwargon when Velgrynd's Space-Time Connection pulled it to the Dwargon eastern front. It never reached Ingracia and fought no battle there. Deliberately given no coordinate.

name: Embassy in the Empire
basis: Inside the imperial capital, offset so the embassy marker does not sit exactly on the capital marker.

name: Settlement (inter-state)
basis: The settlement is a negotiation between states, not a place. Deliberately given no coordinate.

name: Sealed space, Imperial Capital
basis: A severed space with no location on any map. Rendered off-map with an explicit marker.

name: Deployed worldwide
basis: A posture, not a position. Forces carrying this location are not drawn on the map.

name: Position unknown
basis: Reserved for UNKNOWN locations, including Velgrynd's space-time jump (MOV-015, AMB-009). The destination is not stated in the corpus and is not guessed.

name: Green Legion start line
basis: Tactical position inside a single battlefield. The corpus describes these only in relative terms (a start line, a chariot line, about 100 m), which is far below the scale of any supplied map. Offset from the battlefield anchor so the manoeuvre is legible. Not a located point. Clustered within about 10 km of the south-western Dwargon front, in the head of the south-western valley.

name: Imperial main-body camp (~30 km from capital Rimuru)
basis: Soei reports the imperial infantry camped about thirty kilometres from the capital Rimuru with command posts (V13 Ch1, v13.txt:386-389). Placed 30 km from Rimuru under the calibrated scale, on the bearing from the halt point.

name: Imperial camp outside the labyrinth
basis: Where the 170,000 who did not enter the labyrinth stayed, with Caligulio's headquarters tents, until they were annihilated on D+11 (V13 Ch3-4, v13.txt:9489-9493, 9520, 17745-17760). No location is stated beyond 'outside' the labyrinth entrance at the capital. Placed about 12 km east of the Tempest marker, between the capital and the infantry camp.

name: Magitank Force main camp (Gaster's headquarters)
basis: Gaster's main camp lay far behind the battle line (V13 Ch2, v13.txt:5620). Testarossa kills him there. Placed about 25 km back down the south-western valley from the array.

name: Dream Fortress (isolated dimension)
basis: Rimuru's party, teleported by Laplace toward the Imperial Capital, lands in an isolated space in another dimension used to confine troublesome opponents (V14 Ch4 v14.txt:14549-14559, 15754-15770, V15 Ch2 v15.txt:4687-4693, 4747-4750). It has no map position.

name: Emperor's flagship over the Great Jura Forest
basis: The imperial flagship carrying Rudra hangs over the Jura theatre during the dragon battle and the flagship duels (V15 Ch1-Ch5, v15.txt:4771-4772, 11173-11177). Placed as an air layer just north-east of jura-airspace. No finer position is stated.

name: Imperial camp, left flank
basis: Shion breaks the imperial left (v13.txt:17193-17421). The text gives no orientation. The left is placed on the camp's north-east side, facing the labyrinth to the south-west.

name: Imperial camp, right flank
basis: Albis strikes the imperial right (v13.txt:17193-17421). Placed on the camp's south side, facing the labyrinth.

name: Magic Beast Division landing ground
basis: The Legion descends from the airships onto the field in front of the allied line (v15.txt:3404-3420, 7981-7986, 9198-9204). Placed east of the Dwargon defensive line on the isthmus, on the Empire side.

name: Magitank Force rear
basis: Hakuro takes 12,000 on a detour of more than 40 km to the magitank rear (v13.txt:4084-4088). Placed behind the main camp, down the valley.

name: Northern Tempest front (Tempest-Dwargon road)
basis: Scenario: Formation B threatens the logistics link between Tempest and Dwargon in northern Tempest, and the 40,000 northern reinforcement joins this front. Placed on the reconstructed Tempest-Dwargon road (v12.txt:3279-3281) at the massif's southern foot.

name: Dwargon south-western border crossing
basis: Scenario: where Formation B crosses Dwargon's south-western border into the south-western valley. On the traced Dwargon-Jura border of the Base Map.

name: Southern approach to Dwargon
basis: Scenario: the 35,000-strong southern formation approaches Dwargon from the south, east of the Tempest-Dwargon road and south of the Dwargon Gate. Placed in the massif's southern foothills, just outside the Base Map border.

name: Isthmus road (Empire side)
basis: Scenario: the 5,000 detachment's holding position on the Empire side of the Dwargon Gate, on the reconstructed isthmus road.

name: Eastern Great Jura Forest
basis: Moss's clones track imperial squads in the eastern forest while the chariots have not yet moved (v12.txt:12329-12331, 12504-12506). Placed just inside the Jura border on the measured approach route.
